text: The report responds to a request from Councillor De Baeremaeker to review the need for a mid-block pedestrian signal on Eglinton Avenue East at the pathway to the town homes at 2792/2794 Eglinton Avenue East. The pathway at 2792/2794 Eglinton Avenue East is approximately midway between Oswego Road and Barbados Boulevard. Currently, this area is uncontrolled.
City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, referred Item SC28.7 back to the Scarborough Community Council for further consideration at its April 4, 2018 meeting.
